newsitem.title: UK: Sterling settles below 5-year high of 2.91 marks.
newsitem.headline: Sterling settles below 5-year high of 2.91 marks.

text.p: 0650 GMT - Stg/mark 1/4 pfennig below five-year high of 2.91 set overnight. Cable steady above key support at $1.6600.
* Stg/mark at 2.9080/90 vs 2.9026/36 late Monday in Europe. Cable at $1.6648/58 vs $1.6640/45 late yesterday. Pound's trade-weighted index at 102.1 vs six-year high of 102.3 set Monday.
* Focus on UK budget Wednesday with stronger-than-expected UK data yesterday fostering rate-rise expectations. June UK purchasing managers' index out at 0830 GMT.
* CBI's Turner and BoE's George speak at Global 24 international fx conference on EMU. -London newsroom +44 171 542 6284
